discardedRuns.reason: The campaign owner excluded the attempt interrupted by a deploy. Its orphaned hook subsequently finished; that later result is retained only as diagnostic evidence.

continuationEnvironment.reason: Frozen before/after runners capture local process identities and launch host services; this attempt has a private PID namespace. Current supported gate runner uses a different namespace backend and cgroup layout.

readOnlyIdentityProbe.procedure: In one sandboxed Bun process, compare the frozen captureProcessIdentity(process.pid) and current cpuOwnerIdentity(process.pid) with the host self PID from the declared read-only host proc mount. No service, queue ticket or test workload is created.

seatExclusion.reason: Interrupted at the agent deploy boundary; the seat explicitly requires discarding this attempt regardless of a later orphan-hook result.
